answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. What survives to the vertex is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, split across independent auditors, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. The nadir is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the inlet. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
